limitations: Sample size: verified: 120 clips. Confidence intervals are wide at this size; slices under the minimum are marked too small to conclude.
One language: English (en). Results do not transfer to other languages.
Creator captions may not be verbatim (edited, shortened, or translated), which is why the creator tier is reported separately and labelled unverified.

Providers change models without notice. Model ids in this run: synth-a = synth-a-v1 (price checked n/a); synth-b = synth-b-v1 (price checked n/a); synth-c = synth-c-v1 (price checked n/a); synth-d = synth-d-v1 (price checked n/a); synth-e = synth-e-v1 (price checked n/a); synth-f = synth-f-v1 (price checked n/a).
Prices are list prices as of each checked date above, not what any customer actually pays.
YouTube auto captions and Wayin are systems under test, never references.

Not every provider has a result on every clip, so each provider's numbers cover only its own clips (paired tests use the clips both providers scored): synth-b scored 118 of 120 clips (2 error: RuntimeError: synthetic failure).
